extraction.notes: Summer 2027 programs are still being developed. The homepage gives tentative provider-wide weeks of June 13–18 and June 20–25, 2027, but does not assign individual offerings to those weeks; cards therefore retain program-specific 2026 dates. Registration is expected in mid-December 2026, not confirmed for a particular day. The homepage explicitly says 2026 registration is closed, superseding stale waitlist labels on individual pages. Ceramic Pottery's individual page lists both 2026 weeks, whereas the homepage lists only June 14–19. Engineering's homepage lists both weeks, whereas its individual page lists only June 14–19. Pre-Med states a Biology prerequisite. Individual pages were discoverable through official-site search results.
